Image Rotate & Flip

Rotate 90/180/270 degrees and flip, in the browser.

🔄 Drop an image here or click to browse

Exported as PNG at full resolution. Your original file is never modified.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image onto the dropzone or click to browse.
  2. Click rotate left/right and flip horizontal/vertical as needed.
  3. Watch the live preview update.
  4. Download the result as a PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does rotating reduce image quality?

The canvas is re-rendered at the image's full original resolution, then exported as a PNG — no quality is lost in the rotation itself.

Can I rotate and flip at the same time?

Yes — rotate and flip can be combined freely. Each click updates the preview, and the download applies all of them at once.

What format is the download?

It is always exported as PNG, which is lossless. The original file is never modified.
